dace8fe17888e09b.description:
As a Software Tester at Webaxis Software Services, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects and be an integral part of our quality assurance team. We are looking for a talented individual who is passionate about software testing and has a strong understanding of manual testing, usability testing, and software testing processes.

Key responsibilities:
1. Conduct thorough testing of software applications to ensure they meet quality standards and requirements.
2. Develop and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts to identify software defects and bugs.
3. Collaborate with developers and project managers to troubleshoot and resolve issues in a timely manner.
4. Perform regression testing to ensure that software updates and changes do not adversely impact existing functionality.
5. Document and report software defects, track their resolution, and verify fixes.
6. Participate in design reviews and provide feedback on usability and user experience.
7. Stay current on industry trends and best practices in software testing to continuously improve testing processes and methodologies.

If you are a detail-oriented individual with a passion for quality assurance and a desire to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, we would love to hear from you. Join our team at Webaxis Software Services and help us deliver high-quality software solutions to our clients.

da1b0f807870a9fe.description: About the Role We’re looking for a Lead Software Engineer who can build, design, and scale Full-Stack Apps & AgenticAI systems, while also leading projects and engaging directly with customers. If you love solving tough/hard problems at scale, architecting modern distributed systems, and guiding teams to deliver impact, this role is for you. Note: We’re looking for a hands-on Lead Engineer to work alongside the CXOs and own architecture, platform development, customer solutions, delivery and team building. You’ll shape the technical direction, hire and develop the team and establish the practices needed to scale. This role suits someone who wants to help build a company, take responsibility for outcomes, and grow with the business. We're not looking for a mere employee, we're looking for someone who wants to join as a partner in building this together. What You’ll Do * Lead the design and development of complex Full-stack apps and AgenticAI Platform/systems and applications using FastAPI, Node.js, and other modern frameworks. * Drive system design and architecture decisions for highly scalable, distributed platforms. * Build and maintain data pipelines and infrastructure, integrating data streaming technologies. * Work across cloud environments (AWS and Azure), leveraging ECS, Kubernetes, and containerized deployments. * Design and optimize databases, with strong focus on Postgres and vector databases such as Weaviate for search and AI-driven applications. * Develop agentic infrastructure and tooling for next-gen AI workflows. * Collaborate closely with customers and internal teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions. * Mentor and guide engineers, fostering a culture of best practices in code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, and scalability. Must Have Qualifications: * 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with proven ability to deliver and scale systems in production. * Strong knowledge of backend development, APIs, and microservices architectures. * Hands-on experience with system design at scale (high throughput, low latency, fault tolerance). * Proficiency with databases (Postgres, MySQL, or others) and experience with vector DBs (Weaviate, Pinecone, or similar). * Experience building data pipelines (batch + streaming) and working with modern data infrastructure. Using tools like Prefect and Temporal for scalable workloads. * Familiarity with agentic platforms, AI tools, and workflow orchestration is a big plus. * Strong experience with cloud infrastructure (ECS, EKS, AKS, Kubernetes, serverless). * Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders. * Bonus points if you’ve worked with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi), observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry), or DevOps workflows (CI/CD, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.). Why Join Us? * Opportunity to shape architecture and strategy for critical systems. * Work directly with customers and see your solutions in action. * A culture that values autonomy, impact, and learning. * Exposure to cutting-edge AI infrastructure, data platforms, and agentic workflows. * Fast-track your entrepreneurial journey. * Unmatched ownership, exposure, and impact. * Shape the future of AI adoption. This is not a role for the faint-hearted, we’re seeking someone who believes in the transformative power of AI and is driven to shape the future with it. If you’re deeply self-motivated, technically strong, and want to wear the AI Planet badge with pride as we democratize AI for the world, read on.
